overview.tooFewCompare: Too few {{sport}} activities in the compare range to determine a trend ({{count}} of {{min}} needed).
overview.groupDisabledTooltip: Needs at least {{count}} {{mode}}s in the selected range
manage.upload.title: Sync Garmin activities
manage.upload.description: Runs the PowerShell MTP bridge to pull new .FIT files from your Forerunner 965 and import them into the DB. Connect the watch via USB first. Pulls every new file on the device — there's no date range to set here, since the device is diffed against what's already imported, not queried by date.
manage.upload.deviceNotFound: Device not found — plug in via USB
manage.upload.activityFolderInaccessible: Device connected, but its Activity folder isn't accessible
manage.upload.deviceCheckTimeout: Device check timed out — try again
manage.oauth.withings.description: Pulls weight and body composition measurements from the Withings API for the range below (defaults to since your last sync if you leave it alone).
manage.oauth.strava.description: Pulls activities from the Strava API for the range below (defaults to since your last sync if you leave it alone). Activities that match an existing one in time and distance are skipped as likely duplicates rather than double-imported.
manage.oauth.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the popup — allow popups for this site and try again.
manage.oauth.sessionExpired: {{label}} session expired — please log in again
manage.syncAll.title: Sync all
manage.syncAll.description: Runs every sync below in one go — skips whichever source isn't ready (device unplugged, not logged in).
manage.classify.title: AI workout classification
manage.classify.description: Classifies running activities (Recovery Run, Long Session, Repeats/Intervals, Progressive Run, Fartlek, Tapasciata / Light Maintenance) using either a local Ollama model or instant deterministic rules — nothing leaves this machine either way. Each batch run here uses one method (switch below); the single-activity detail view can run and compare both. Reclassifying is always allowed, even on an already-confirmed activity, and resets it back to pending review.
manage.classify.noActivities: No running activities in this range.
manage.classify.methodTooltip: Classification method: a local Ollama model, or instant deterministic rules over the same pace-variance/split/pause stats (no LLM, works even if Ollama isn't running)
manage.classify.confirmTooltip: Bulk-approves the {{method}} classification for already-classified selected activities, no reason needed — same as thumbs-up per activity
manage.dateRanges.title: Named date ranges
manage.dateRanges.description: Save a training-block window to recall and compare later — e.g. week 2 vs week 3 of Boston Marathon prep, or one race's build-up vs another's. Optionally link the race it led up to; only races that took place after the range's end date are selectable.
manage.dateRanges.pickToEdit: Pick a saved range to edit…
manage.dateRanges.pickFirstTooltip: Pick a saved range above first
manage.dateRanges.pickToDelete: Pick a saved range to delete…
manage.delete.title: Delete data range
manage.delete.description: Moves records to the local database's trash (below) rather than removing them outright — restore them any time, or empty the trash to permanently reclaim the space. Nothing is touched on your Garmin watch, Strava, or Withings account either way, and a resync won't bring a trashed (or permanently deleted) item back on its own.
manage.trash.title: Trash
manage.trash.refreshTooltip: Refresh — e.g. after deleting something above
manage.trash.description: Items deleted above land here first. Restore brings them straight back; emptying the trash permanently deletes them (their data is wiped to reclaim space, but enough is kept internally that a resync still won't reimport them).
manage.trash.purgeTooltip: Permanently deletes the selected item(s) — this can't be undone. The filename/date is still kept internally so a resync won't bring it back.
manage.trash.confirmPurge: Permanently delete {{n}} item(s)? This can't be undone.
settings.units.currentlyNote: currently: {{system}} (from your browser's locale — there's no direct way to read the OS's actual measurement-system setting)
settings.units.title: Units
settings.units.description: Applies to distance, pace, speed, elevation and weight everywhere in the app. "Auto" guesses from your browser's language/region (e.g. a US locale defaults to imperial) — there's no direct way for a web page to read the OS's actual measurement-system setting, so this is a best-effort default you can always override.
settings.dateFormat.title: Date format
settings.dateFormat.description: Applies to every date shown in the app. "Numeric" is dd/mm or mm/dd depending on region; "Literal" spells the month out. Overview & Trends' chart axes always stay numeric (no room for a spelled-out month on a compact axis tick) but still follow the region here.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.accentDescription: Accent color — governs buttons, active pills, links and focus rings only; never chart/data colors
settings.appearance.stylePackDescription: Style pack — a full palette (background, borders, radius, shadows), independent of theme and accent
settings.activityDetails.title: Activity details
settings.activityDetails.description: How clicking an activity in the Activities tab opens its detail — expand inline in the list, or open as a popup.
settings.overviewTrends.title: Overview & Trends
settings.overviewTrends.description: Minimum activities needed before a sport's trend chart is shown (in "Single" mode), or before "Week"/"Month" grouping is offered — below this, a "too few activities" message is shown instead of a chart that would only have a couple of bars.
settings.outliers.title: Outlier detection
settings.outliers.description: Used by the activity chart's "Remove outliers" checkbox. Two independent rules: an isolated-spike filter (a point is flagged only when it jumps away and back from its neighbors faster than the rate below, so a genuine sustained change like a real sprint isn't affected), and an absolute floor for Speed/Pace — any sample slower than the walking-pace threshold is dropped outright, for a "running only" view.
settings.outliers.minSpeedFieldLabel: Min speed to count as running (km/h)
app.serverUnreachable: API server unreachable — run: cd garmin-stats && node src/server.ts
api.gatewayError: Couldn't reach the API server ({{status}}). It may be busy, restarting, or a long request (e.g. the AI classifier) timed out — the operation may still have finished, so wait a moment and try again.
api.networkError: Couldn't reach the API server. It may be down, restarting, or a long request was interrupted — the operation may still have finished, so wait a moment and try again.
common.rangeEmpty.noneYet: No {{entity}} yet — sync some data from the Data & Sync tab.
common.rangeEmpty.notInRange: No {{entity}} in the selected range ({{from}} to {{to}}). Data available from {{minDate}} to {{maxDate}}.

body.chart.checkMetric: Check at least one metric above to plot.
body.chart.noDataInRange: No data for this metric in range
body.primaryChartTitle: Weight, fat mass & muscle mass — change since start of range ({{unit}})
body.correlationEmpty: No overlapping activity/body data for correlation in this range.
activity.detail.deleteTooltip: Moves this activity to the local database's trash (Data & Sync tab) — it's not touched on your Garmin device, Strava, or Withings account, and you can restore it later. A resync won't bring it back on its own.
activity.chart.removeOutliersTooltip: Drops isolated bad samples (GPS/sensor noise) from Speed/Pace and Cadence, plus any Speed/Pace sample slower than walking pace — thresholds adjustable in Settings
activity.chart.hrRecoveryFlagsNote: flags show HR recovery across each pause
activity.classify.aiTooltip: Runs a local Ollama model against this activity's pace/HR pattern (takes ~15-25s on CPU). Always available, even if already classified — reclassifying resets the activity's shared review verdict back to pending.
activity.classify.statisticalTooltip: Applies deterministic rules to this activity's pace variance, splits, and pauses — instant, no Ollama needed. Always available, even if already classified — reclassifying resets the activity's shared review verdict back to pending.
activity.classify.verdictSourceTooltip: This card's result is the activity's confirmed classification
activity.classify.approveTooltip: Confirm this card's classification as the activity's answer
activity.classify.splitTooltip: Split granularity used to (re)classify — finer splits can surface short interval structure a coarser split smooths out
runplan.accordion.defaultSectionName: Name follows the plan's own name — {{name}}
runplan.accordion.needsReview: This day needs review before it can be saved.
manage.planTemplates.title: Training-plan templates
manage.planTemplates.description: Reusable RunPlan DSL v1 templates — paced generically (symbolic anchors like RG), instantiated per race with concrete paces and a start date.
manage.planTemplates.deleteConfirm: Delete? This also removes every instance derived from it.
manage.planTemplates.generateFailed: Failed to parse the DSL text
manage.planTemplates.patchFailed: Could not apply this edit — the underlying text may have changed unexpectedly.
manage.planInstances.title: Training-plan instances
manage.planInstances.description: A concrete instantiation of a template for one race — resolved paces, a start date, and (optionally) a linked race activity.
manage.planInstances.noTemplates: Save a template first — an instance is always created from one.
